## Display choices and thresholds

- **VT-GAS-DEPTH.** the fade at the sample's edges is a drawing convention — the sample ends, the gas does not; the sample's boundary is drawn, labelled, only in "show the physics"
- **VT-THERM-WRITE.** one mark per representative atom (a few hundred, SCI-REP-001)
- **VT-PARCEL-GAS.** about 36 atoms for the toy's parcel, from 1 to 160 across the amount's domain; motion slowed for display and frozen under reduced motion
- **VT-PARCEL-BEFORE.** measured from the two computed profiles (never typed) on a grid that extends the drawn stretch by grid_pad_kms on each side at the drawing's spacing; not printed when either profile still exceeds edge_max of its peak at that grid's ends Thresholds: grid_pad_kms = 300, grid_points = 2200, edge_max = 0.001.
- **VT-MAP-FIBRES.** one thread per 4th sub-cell of 161 within ±2.75σ of the parcel; opacity ∝ (the sub-cell's share of the column)^1.6, so the topology shows and the loom does not
- **VT-FLUX-LIGHT.** the halo's strength at each colour is the transmitted fraction there (dark troughs cast no light), falling off over 16 px; paper fibres show only in that light; the ribbon's own pixels are checked against e^(−τ)
- **VT-INV-TRACE.** Thresholds: kernel_cut_b = 6, cell_min_fraction = 0.01, group_gap_mpch = 0.25, traced_min_share = 0.05, places_min_share = 0.15, ledger_terms = 3. a cell under cell_min_fraction of the colour's τ is not drawn on its own and regions under traced_min_share get no thread; their optical depth stays in the ledger's "rest", so the written sum is the colour's total τ exactly
